realm_description: The beating civic center of every continent — capitals, universities, and Guild Headquarters all rise here. This is where community becomes something larger than any one person.

primary.label: Democrat
primary.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
primary.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
primary.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

secondary.label: Sage
secondary.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
secondary.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

wheel.central_question: Should power come from everyone, or from the exceptional?

growth.label: Sage
growth.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
growth.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
growth.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

other_ally.label: Craftsman
other_ally.description: Believes excellence lives in the smallest details; discipline borders on devotion.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will refine this until it is right, no matter how long that takes.
other_ally.shadow_description: Keeps refining what was already good enough, and calls the compulsion discipline.

quarter.label: Strategist
quarter.description: Plays the long game; every move is calculated toward winning.
quarter.guiding_promise: Every move I make today is setting up tomorrow's victory.
quarter.shadow_description: Starts treating the people around them as pieces to be played, not ends in themselves.

opposite.label: Aristocrat
opposite.description: Leads with inherited certainty and intuitive command.
opposite.guiding_promise: I carry the weight of legacy and lead with the confidence it bestows.
opposite.shadow_description: Mistakes inherited certainty for earned worth, and dismisses anyone without the pedigree to match.

realmmate.label: Bureaucrat
realmmate.description: Finds safety and fairness in process, dreads chaos.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I build the structures that protect what matters from chaos.
realmmate.shadow_description: Clings to the process long after it stops serving the people it was built to protect.

wheel.compatible_text: Bureaucrat · Judge — fellow travelers of The Living Heart.
